sources.title: hruslen/SpaceInvadersNoFrameskip-v4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a trained model of a DQN agent playing SpaceInvadersNoFrameskip-v4 using the stable-baselines3 library and the RL Zoo. The RL Zoo is a training framework for Stable Baselines3 reinforcement learning agents, with hyperparameter optimization and pre-trained agents included.
